source.section: 5.1 proposed interface signals; 4.1 Board B status and mute

signals.evidence: Product architecture §5.1: 5 V B to A; voltage tolerances and contact count remain open.
signals.nominal_logic_level: 5 V supply, not a logic level
signals.power_off_behavior: No source/backfeed when B off or connector open
signals.buffer_translation: No translation; power-path protection and current sharing R4
signals.return_adjacency: Pair power with nearby GND contacts

signals.evidence: Product architecture §§5.1, 6: multiple low-impedance return contacts; exact count and allocation open.
signals.clock_data_relationship: Return for power, clocks and status
signals.power_off_behavior: Open return invalidates interface and must not permit amplifier enable
signals.buffer_translation: No translation; connector current/ground strategy R4
signals.return_adjacency: Ground adjacent to 5 V and fast audio groups

signals.evidence: TI TAS5825M SLASEH7H pp.7,28-30: 96-kHz 32-bit stereo I2S slave, BCLK=6.144 MHz, LRCLK=96 kHz, SDIN from Board A. NXP IMXRT1060CEC Rev4 p.61 Table 50: SAI master BCLK cycle >=40 ns. Exact SAI mux, loaded edges and voltage-bank allocation remain R3 open.
signals.clock_data_relationship: SAI2 I2S 6.144 MHz, 64 BCLK per 96-kHz stereo frame
signals.safe_default_state: undefined until A clock init; B PDN low
signals.power_off_behavior: A output must not backfeed unpowered B; B remains inhibited
signals.buffer_translation: No voltage translation planned; buffer/series/isolation if R4 drive/Ioff/timing requires

conditional_candidate.conditions: NXP <=1 mA source load; LVC <=100 uA output load; LVC and TAS share identical B 3V3 rail (3.0-3.6 V); TAS 25-C logic specification; rail/off-state pending

signals.evidence: TI TAS5825M SLASEH7H pp.1,28-29: three-wire LRCLK/SCLK/SDIN serial port; internal PLL derives clocks from SCLK, so no forwarded MCLK is required for the R2 candidate. Retain as optional only if R3 changes endpoint architecture.
signals.clock_data_relationship: TAS5825M uses three-wire I2S and internal PLL from SCLK

signals.evidence: TI TAS5825M SLASEH7H pp.4,6-7,34: DVDD-referenced I2C, DVDD 1.62-3.63 V; NXP IMXRT1060CEC Rev4 pp.2,25-26: I2C and 3.0-3.6-V NVCC_GPIO bank. Pullups, address resistor, bus capacitance and unpowered isolation remain R3 open.
signals.clock_data_relationship: A master data with B slave ACK; used only after B PGOOD and A rails valid
signals.safe_default_state: no bus activity; B PDN low
signals.power_off_behavior: No pull-up-driven injection into either unpowered domain
signals.buffer_translation: Powered-off isolation required unless R4 proves Ioff-safe direct path; no nominal translation

signals.evidence: TI TAS5825M SLASEH7H pp.4,6-7,34: DVDD-referenced I2C, DVDD 1.62-3.63 V; NXP IMXRT1060CEC Rev4 pp.2,25-26: I2C and 3.0-3.6-V NVCC_GPIO bank. Pullups, address resistor, bus capacitance and unpowered isolation remain R3 open.
signals.clock_data_relationship: Board A master generates SCL; TAS5825M slave receives; B clock stretching not assumed
signals.safe_default_state: no bus activity; B PDN low
signals.power_off_behavior: No pull-up-driven injection into either unpowered domain
signals.buffer_translation: Powered-off isolation required unless R4 proves Ioff-safe direct path; no nominal translation

signals.evidence: TI TAS5825M SLASEH7H pp.4,42-43: pin 17 PDN is active-low hardware shutdown; product AMP_MUTE may drive an independent inhibit/PDN logic path. Polarity conversion, default pull, watchdog ORing and response remain R3/R4 open.
signals.nominal_logic_level: high permits PDN release; low asserts hardware mute
signals.clock_data_relationship: Independent of I2S edges; A watchdog gate plus B local PGOOD gate
signals.power_off_behavior: B fail-low pull; A off or cable open cannot enable amp
signals.buffer_translation: Off-domain-safe input/gate required; level translation not planned

signals.evidence: TI TAS5825M SLASEH7H pp.4,43,77-80: GPIO0-2 configurable as FAULTZ open-drain or CMOS; no dedicated fixed FAULT pin. Configuration, pullup and validity before amp initialization remain R3/R4 open.
signals.nominal_logic_level: configured FAULTZ active-low; invalid before configuration
signals.clock_data_relationship: Status sampled after amp GPIO configuration; never sole hardware inhibit
signals.safe_default_state: unavailable is not permission to Play
signals.power_off_behavior: Must not inject into unpowered A; B fault response is local
signals.buffer_translation: Open-drain pull-up on A powered side with R4 off-domain protection

signals.evidence: TAS5825M SLASEH7H pp.4-5 pin table has no PGOOD output; Board B must produce PGOOD from selected power/protection/supervisor circuit. Voltage, polarity and sequencing remain R3/R4 open.
signals.nominal_logic_level: high = B protected PVDD, 5 V and B logic valid; low = unsafe
signals.clock_data_relationship: Hardware supervisor output; local B signal also gates PDN
signals.power_off_behavior: A input fail-low; no backfeed when A off or B off
signals.buffer_translation: Off-domain-safe status output/input required; no nominal translation planned

signals.evidence: Product architecture §5.1 lists revision detect/spare GPIO as optional/DNP; minimum justified service only.
signals.clock_data_relationship: No R3 service need across board boundary

phase_basis: R3 selected 96-kHz architecture; logical inventory and minimum contact plan, no connector/pin freeze
open_contract_items: R4 maximum/current derating and final 5-V/GND contact allocation
R4 exact SAI pin mux/PLL/frame phase, loaded setup/hold, edge quality and off-domain protection
R4 I2C isolation/pullups/address/speed and bus capacitance
R4 AMP_MUTE-to-PDN watchdog/PGOOD gate, fault polarity/validity and timed safe response
R7 connector family, keying, stack and exact pin order

r4_audit.reason: Worst-case digital DC, timing, off-domain and 5-V/contact-current proof incomplete
r4_audit.clock_plan: 24 MHz reference -> PLL4 786.432 MHz /4 -> SAI1/2 roots 24.576 MHz -> 12.288 MHz ADC and 6.144 MHz amp BCLK
r4_audit.unresolved: Loaded DC/timing, off-state, 5-V/return contact current and hardware-safe response proof remain incomplete.
